requirements.summary: Create a gaming application with interactive gameplay mechanics
acceptanceCriteria: User can start and play a game
Game state is managed and persisted in the backend

file_operations.description: Create the main 2D game component with interactive gameplay mechanics including game initialization, user controls, collision detection, scoring system, and visual feedback. Integrate generated images from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/controller-icon.dim_128x128.png as static assets in the game UI. Implement game state management that calls backend capabilities for score persistence.

Create a custom hook to manage game state including current score, game status (idle/playing/paused/gameover), player position, and game objects. Handle backend integration for saving and loading game progress.

Create the game page that hosts the Game component, displays game instructions, start/pause/restart controls, and current score. Wire the generated hero banner image from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png as a header element.

Add route for /game pointing to GamePage component. Update navigation to include a link to the game page with the controller icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/controller-icon.dim_128x128.png.

requirements.summary: Implement a visually engaging game interface with smooth animations and responsive controls
acceptanceCriteria: Visual feedback is provided for user actions

file_operations.description: Add smooth CSS animations and transitions for game elements including player movement, object interactions, score updates, and game state changes. Implement requestAnimationFrame for smooth rendering. Add visual feedback for collisions, scoring events, and control inputs using animation keyframes and state-driven class changes.

Create an intuitive control panel component with buttons for game actions (start, pause, restart) and keyboard event listeners for gameplay controls. Include visual states for button presses and hover effects. Reference the controller icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/controller-icon.dim_128x128.png for control indicators.

Create game-specific styles including keyframe animations for smooth element movement, collision effects, score popup animations, particle effects for visual feedback, and responsive control layouts. Use hardware-accelerated CSS properties for optimal performance.

requirements.summary: Design a creative and cohesive visual theme for the gaming app using bold, vibrant colors, dynamic typography, and a modern gaming aesthetic
acceptanceCriteria: Visual theme is consistently applied across all screens
Color palette is vibrant and suitable for gaming
Typography and layout support an engaging user experience

file_operations.description: Update global styles with a vibrant gaming color palette featuring energetic colors (avoiding blue and purple unless specifically needed), bold typography settings, and modern gaming aesthetic variables. Define CSS custom properties for primary gaming colors (e.g., neon greens, oranges, yellows, reds), accent colors, and gradient combinations. Set up dynamic font weights and gaming-appropriate font stacks.

Extend Tailwind configuration with custom gaming theme colors (vibrant greens, oranges, yellows, reds, avoiding blue/purple), add custom font families with bold weights suitable for gaming interfaces, define animation utilities for dynamic effects, and configure spacing/sizing scales appropriate for game UI elements.

Create a layout component that wraps game pages with consistent branding elements including the hero banner from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png, navigation with the controller icon from frontend/public/assets/generated/controller-icon.dim_128x128.png, and themed containers. Apply the vibrant color scheme and dynamic typography consistently.

Wrap the game page content in GameLayout component to ensure consistent theme application. Apply gaming-themed styling classes and ensure all text uses the dynamic typography defined in the global styles.
